record.source_text: If the precise determination of income-related expenses is associated with disproportionate difficulties, the Federal Minister of Finance may, in addition to the flat-rate amount for income-related expenses pursuant to Section 16(3), establish average rates for income-related expenses by regulation for certain groups of taxpayers according to the respective practical experience.
